content:
rachel_pm: proposing a lightweight interop/conformance kit for LangChain + LlamaIndex agent flows + gateway tool-calls. aim: 1 page checklist + runnable tests. thoughts?

tom_infra: love it. infra can host the harness. want it containerized so partners can run locally too.

oliver_eng: agree. minimal tests: vector ingest, retrieval accuracy smoke, agent->tool end-to-end, streaming + fallbacks. each test should have a pass/fail and a small log sample.

nina_partners: partners want clear acceptance criteria for marketplace listing. can we include a badges matrix (sandbox-ready, streaming, tool-calls)?

sprint-bot: created repo: `github.com/redwood/interop-kit-agentflow` and seeded README.

rachel_pm: badge matrix sounds good. marketing wants a short blurb for each badge. evan_mktg can you draft?

evAN_mktg: evan_mktg: can do. will draft 3 blurbs: "sandbox-ready", "agent-ready", "gateway-tested". need customer-friendly wording.

oliver_eng: technical proposal for tests:
- ingest: sample CSV -> LlamaIndex index -> check vector count
- retrieval: top1 contains expected doc id (exact match)
- agent: langchain agent executes lookup -> executes mock tool via gateway and returns structured JSON
- streaming: client receives incremental chunks
- scaling: cold-start latency under 800ms for first token (local infra profile)

oliver_eng: I'll add a docker-compose + small go/python harness that runs tests and writes `results.json` (simple pass/fail + stdout snippet).

tom_infra: we'll wire a short-lived cluster for the CI job. do we need GPU? small quantized model ok on CPU for the smoke tests, but include an optional GPU path.

rachel_pm: timeline: prototype by Mar 2, partner trials Mar 6 6, marketplace badge gating Mar 20.

nina_partners: legal wants a one-line disclaimer for the badge and opt-in consent for partners to be listed. @legal_clara please advise.

legal_clara: can provide a short consent template and a co-marketing consent checkbox for the partner onboarding flow. will post in repo under `LEGAL/consent-template.md`.

evAN_mktg: (correction) will post drafts in `marketing/assets/badges.md` by Feb 24.

oliver_eng: sample CLI for partners to run locally:
```
# run whole suite
docker-compose up --build --exit-code-from tester
# or run single test
./interop-test --test retrieval --endpoint https://sandbox.redwood.dev --token $TOKEN
```

rachel_pm: we also need a short acceptance email template for partners once they pass. nina can you own?

nina_partners: yes. will craft and include a partner-facing README w/ next steps for marketplace listing.

tom_infra: SSO note: sandbox will use OAuth invites. if partner needs SAML we can onboard later. also enabling rate limits and a model-fallback policy.

oliver_eng: telemetry: include p95 latency, token-cost estimate, and a deterministic test seed for retrieval so runs are comparable. will add instrumentation hooks.

evAN_mktg: marketing wants 15s demo GIFs for each badge; we can auto-record a sample run in CI and upload. neato.

rachel_pm: action items:
- oliver -> initial harness + docker-compose + tests (due Feb 22)
- tom -> CI infra + optional GPU path + rate limits (due Feb 25)
- nina -> partner README + acceptance email + onboarding checklist (due Feb 24)
- evan_mktg -> badges copy + demo GIF CI job (due Feb 27)
- legal_clara -> consent template + marketplace terms note (due Feb 23)

oliver_eng: noted. will open draft PR and tag everyone.

nina_partners: quick ask 1 replay prompts for retrieval/agents. partners prefer to supply but we should seed with neutral dataset.

rachel_pm: let's seed with public docs (privacy-safe). tom, can you provision a small wiki corpus?

tom_infra: yes. I'll seed a 200-doc corpus and commit to `data/seed/wiki-sample`.

sprint-bot: scheduled reminder: design review Mar 1 16:00 UTC in #partners-review.

rachel_pm: perfect. keeping this thread as the canonical coordination thread. if anyone hits blockers ping me or escalate to Partnerships.

legal_clara: added LEGAL note to the repo.

oliver_eng: PR opened: `feat/interop-harness` 1 includes basic retrieval + agent test scaffolding. linking logs in PR.

nina_partners: thanks all, will start outreach to 3 pilot partners next week.

rachel_pm: thanks team. closing loop for now.
